events.text:
I merged one pair, C-1440 into C-1001 ("Pellham Industrial"). The other 84 are not merged yet.

- **Why only one:** The tool returned a summary and a CSV filename (`duplicates_2026-10-21.csv`), not the full list of pairs. The only pair I could see with matching name, address and tax ID was C-1001/C-1440, so I merged that one. I can't merge the rest without their IDs.
- **73 pairs match on name, address and tax ID.** These are safe to merge. I need the pair IDs from the CSV, with the record to keep for each pair.
- **12 pairs match on name and address but have different tax IDs.** I have not touched these. They may be separate legal entities, for example C-2210/C-2875 "Ridgeview Holdings" (tax IDs 41-0091822 and 41-0091950). Merges can't be undone, so Morgan Lee should confirm each of these before I merge it.

If you paste the CSV contents, I'll merge the 73 clear matches and leave the 12 for review.
